prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE landscape 16:10 cinematic full-bleed illustration for the FIRST-MATCH CORNER PREPARATION scene in Wrestling from Marigold, Chicago 1952. Strict BLACK AND WHITE / GRAYSCALE illustrated televised presentation, no color tint. Image 1 is APPROVED Guido FACE: exact youthful clean-shaven face, dark wavy forelock, dark eyes and brows, same nose/jaw, 21-year-old. Image 2 is Guido compact muscular build authority, not costume. Image 3 is APPROVED TRAINER identity/build: middle-aged Black man, broad expressive face, receding cropped hair, thick neat moustache, stocky shoulders; plain short-sleeved work shirt, dark full-leg slacks, off-white cotton towel around neck. Image 4 reinforces both identities and their approved drawn rendering, not setting. Image 5 is broadcast grayscale and graphic INK/FLAT SHADING authority, NOT character identity.
SCENE: eye-level medium-wide TWO-SHOT at Guido's corner of an ordinary period wrestling ring. Guido on RIGHT stands inside the ring, back close to a single padded corner post/turnbuckles, body three-quarter turned LEFT toward trainer. Trainer on LEFT stands beside him INSIDE THE SAME CORNER for pre-bell advice, also inside ropes, leaning slightly toward Guido. Show both complete heads to just below knees; faces and mouths fully unobstructed and easy to read, both men's hands visible. No handshake, embrace, chest-touch, aggressive pointing or physical drama. Trainer uses ONE hand to straighten the robe lapel at Guido's upper chest while his other hand rests by his own side; Guido's arms relaxed, RIGHT wrist wrapped once with plain WHITE athletic tape, LEFT wrist bare. Calm concentrated trainer with mouth slightly parted as if giving a short instruction, Guido listening with restrained nervous resolve, not smiling or scowling.
CRITICAL FIRST-MATCH WARDROBE: Guido wears the trainer's OLD BORROWED ROBE. A plain worn charcoal-gray cotton/satin boxing-style robe, knee length, slightly too roomy, sleeves ending above wrist, tired frayed cuffs and light worn edging. Open loosely at front over plain trunks (wine-red canon rendered dark gray here), loosely hanging belt ends, no hood, no plush bathrobe texture or luxury trim. Give robe ONE SMALL clearly visible old TEAR at the OUTER LOWER HEM near Guido's knee: ragged 2-inch split, a couple of loose threads, not huge shredded costume or injury. Tear must be readable and ABOVE lower caption-safe 15% of composition. NO MORETTI, initials, logos, embroidery, patches or other lettering anywhere: his named robe comes AFTER this first match. No star ornament, personalized robe, jewelry or knee pads.
RING GEOGRAPHY: one padded corner post behind Guido at far RIGHT, three ropes receding naturally from that corner along TWO sides of ring, no rope through faces or either body. Trainer and Guido stand on same canvas inside ropes, proper scale, do not place trainer on ropes or outside impossible geometry. Faint soft indistinct spectators BEYOND ropes, a few dim overhead light shapes; keep crowd and far ropes low contrast so characters dominate. A little atmospheric haze in background only, no heavy smoke over faces, no modern giant stadium or LED lights. Normal lens, no extreme low angle, fisheye or Dutch tilt.
STYLE: confidently HAND-DRAWN tapered black outlines, sparse selected facial lines, 3-4 simple grayscale shadow groups, clean graphic cloth folds, controlled subtle paper texture only. Avoid photorealistic skin, dense painted texture, 3D gloss, detailed pores, smooth airbrush shading, heavy grain or hatching. Keep dark robe separate from charcoal trainer shirt through gray value differences. Quiet lower 15% for future editable advice caption, but NO baked text, subtitles, UI, borders, watermarks or speech balloons. One coherent finished composition, not layered cutouts, no multiple panels or mouths. Overscan 5% for modest camera push.
continuityCorrection: Use case: precise-object-edit. Make ONLY these continuity/wardrobe corrections to the supplied grayscale Guido/trainer corner illustration. Preserve exact faces, hair, expressions, body proportions, poses, trainer, ring geometry, framing, grayscale inked shading and full landscape canvas. 1. WRIST TAPE: remove white tape from Guido's wrist on SCREEN RIGHT (the hand nearest the corner post). That wrist must be bare skin. Add the SAME plain narrow white wrist wrap to Guido's wrist on SCREEN LEFT (the relaxed hand closer to trainer at lower center). This preserves his established taped RIGHT wrist; do not mirror or move the men. Fingers remain bare, no hand bandages. 2. ROBE: retain ONE small ragged tear at lower hem near screen-right knee, but make it a modest short split with a few loose threads rather than a deep triangular chunk missing. Repair both sleeve cuffs to mostly intact worn seams with slight fraying only, not shredded edges. Keep robe old, plain dark gray, slightly oversized and unlettered, no MORETTI yet, no fancy trim. Do not add color, jewelry, text or new props. Keep all other pixels/layout as consistent as possible, no face redesign or camera change.
